packageRules.description: Rust workspace deps: group non-major updates, keep majors as their own PR
Website npm deps: group non-major updates
GitHub Actions: group all updates (SHA-pinned, comment updated in place)

TypeScript is held below 6.1.0 because typescript-eslint -- and @typescript-eslint/parser plus eslint-plugin, all three carry the cap -- peers it at >=4.8.4 <6.1.0 (unchanged in 8.71.2, the latest release, and in its canaries), and it refuses to run at all when handed TS 7. This is not conservatism: TypeScript 7 is the Go rewrite and 7.0 ships no JavaScript compiler API for the parser to call, so 7.0 support was closed as not planned and the target is TS 7.1+ (typescript-eslint#10940). Note the rule blocks only the uninstallable 7.x; 6.0.x is still allowed. Lift it once the peer range widens.
